system.description:
Category: Ninjutsu

You have created a minor pocket dimension that follows you, that you can use to store items inside. You gain the following Benefits;

You manifest a pocket dimension that you can interact with. This pocket dimension has a maximum bulk limit of 25. Time passes normally inside this pocket dimension, meaning things can expire or spoil as normal while stored within.

As a bonus action you can store any item you are holding or wearing, except armor, into the pocket dimension. Once per turn, as an Object interact action you can retrieve any item stored within the pocket dimension.

If you are killed, all items in your pocket dimension are expelled and fall occupying random spaces within 10 feet of you.

Another creature who is aware of your Pocket dimension can cast a jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword targeting you and make an Intelligence (Ninshou) check vs your Ninshou DC. On a success, they tear open your pocket dimension pulling out any item they are looking for. The original effect of the jutsu does not need to be applied if they are doing this.
